claim_verdicts.evidence: OTel .NET Sampling page: "By reducing the number of collected spans, sampling helps control overhead and telemetry volume." refs dotnet-docs distributed-tracing-concepts.md: "For improved performance in high throughput applications, distributed tracing on .NET supports sampling only a subset of traces rather than recording all of them." (round 1 evidence, claim unchanged)

OTel .NET Sampling page: "sampling decisions are typically made when a trace is started (head-based sampling)". Tail-based sampling page: "head-based sampling, which makes decisions at the beginning of the trace." (round 1 evidence, claim unchanged)

Round 2: ActivityTraceFlags API page: "Specifies flags defined by the W3C standard that are associated with an activity." "This enumeration supports a bitwise combination of its member values." Fields: "None | 0 | The activity has not been marked." "Recorded | 1 | The activity (or more likely its parents) has been marked as useful to record." So the sampled/recorded flag is the bit of value 1 (lowest bit). Round 1: tempo.sh builds 00-<trace>-<span>-01/00; captured run 1 vs 0 spans.

Ledger text now equals the round 1 suggested_text. OTel .NET Sampling page: ParentBased "Uses the sampling decision of the parent span when one exists." "If there is no parent, it delegates to a root sampler." Program.cs passes the root sampler to the constructor: new ParentBasedSampler(new TraceIdRatioBasedSampler(sampleRatio)).

Round 2: "computed from the trace id" removed from claim and lesson. OTel .NET Sampling page: TraceIdRatioBased "Samples traces based on a fixed probability" (example 10%). Program.cs passes the probability to the constructor: new TraceIdRatioBasedSampler(sampleRatio).

Round 2: claim narrowed to the round 1 suggested_text (single-service evidence + services that follow the flag). OTel .NET Sampling page: "Sampling controls which traces are recorded and exported." Captured output: "spans in Tempo for the trace marked 00: 0". Also supports the new s4 sentence "the services never record or send the spans of a dropped trace".

OTel .NET tail-based sampling page: "Tail-based sampling makes sampling decisions after the trace has been completed". Repo: deploy/monitoring/alloy/config.alloy has only otelcol.receiver.otlp -> otelcol.processor.batch -> otelcol.exporter.otlp "tempo"; no sampling processor. (round 1 evidence, claim unchanged)

OTel .NET Sampling page: TraceIdRatioBased "Samples traces based on a fixed probability" (example: 10%). Probability 0.1 of keeping gives 0.9 dropped on average; decided at the start (claim 2), so an error trace is not favoured. (round 1, unchanged)

DonHang.Api/Program.cs L106: var sampleRatio = builder.Configuration.GetValue("Telemetry:SampleRatio", 0.1); L110: .SetSampler(new ParentBasedSampler(new TraceIdRatioBasedSampler(sampleRatio))). Code block not changed in round 1 apply-review; round 1 match stands.

refs aspnetcore-docs configuration: "If `NumberKey` isn't found in the configuration, the default value of `99` is used." and "A double underscore (`__`) is supported by all platforms and is automatically converted into a colon (`:`) when the configuration is read by the app." Supports the new s5 wording "which configuration reads as Telemetry:SampleRatio".
